caseName: Head v. New Mexico Board of Examiners in Optometry
caseNameFull: Head, doing business as Lea County Publishing Co. v. New Mexico Board of Examiners in Optometry
attorneys: Ellis Lyons, Leonard J. Emmerglick and Harold Kohn on the motion.

opinions.text: Appeal from the Supreme Court of New Mexico. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 371 U. S. 900.) The motion of the American Optometric Association, Inc., for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, is granted.
